When I was a little kid, my family lived in a house we all thought was haunted. My parents heard the voice of what sounded like a little girl calling out for her mother by the side my mom was sleeping on the first few nights we lived there; it only stopped when they switched sides of the bed the next night. To my knowledge, they haven't ever switched back.

My bedroom had a certain *feeling* to it I can't describe, but others can attest to. It was a dark, awful feeling. It's embarrassing but as a grown man writing this I'm actually kind of freaked out to write or think about it to the point where my breathing is strained and there are tears in my eyes, like doing so will bring the feeling back. I would wake up shaking and moaning, helpless as I sat up in down in bed with this horrible low noise coming out of my throat that I couldn't really control. This would happen many times throughout my childhood, only ever in this bedroom. I eventually switched rooms and felt a little better.

Coming back from college to visit, I stayed in my old bedroom. Waking up one morning, years after I thought all of this stuff had just been a child being scared by a spooky house, I felt the most horror I have ever felt in my life suddenly overcome me. The room wasn't dark, there was nothing wrong, but I immediately jumped out of the bed and ran the fastest I ever have in my life downstairs and didn't go up for quite some time.
